stories.title: Public sector strike suspended as unions agree pay deal
stories.why_it_matters: Suspending the strike avoids the disruption it would have caused and shows the pay dispute is moving toward a settlement.

stories.title: 50 leaders in Dublin for State's largest diplomatic event
stories.why_it_matters: It is the biggest diplomatic event the State has hosted, which puts Ireland at the centre of European political discussions.

stories.title: US proposed Donbas swap for NATO membership - Zelensky
stories.why_it_matters: A proposal linking territory to NATO membership bears directly on Ukraine's borders and its future security.

stories.title: Trump, Xi and Putin to meet in China next week
stories.why_it_matters: It would bring together the leaders of three major powers in a format that has never happened before.
